title: Code-Mixed Hinglish Sentiment Classifier
description: Classifies sentiment in messages that mix Hindi written in Roman letters with English, handling inconsistent spellings and comparing a character-level model with a word-level one.

title: Contract Deadline and Renewal Date Extractor
description: Finds notice periods, renewal dates and payment deadlines in contract text, normalises relative expressions such as thirty days after signing, and lists them in a calendar view.

title: Commit Message Generator from Code Diffs
description: Generates short imperative commit messages from a code diff with a sequence model, and evaluates them against real commit messages using overlap metrics and a manual quality check.

title: Duplicate Question Detector for a Programming Forum
description: Flags new questions that repeat an existing one by comparing meaning rather than wording, and measures how many true duplicates surface in the top five suggestions.

title: Lecture Transcript Glossary Builder
description: Pulls out the technical terms a lecturer defines in a transcript and assembles a glossary with a definition sentence and first-mention timestamp for each term.

title: Clickbait Headline Detector
description: Trains a classifier to separate clickbait from informative headlines and shows which words and patterns push a headline towards each label.

title: Review Helpfulness Predictor
description: Predicts how useful a product review will be to other shoppers from its text, length and detail, and checks whether the model simply rewards long reviews.

title: Poetry Meter and Rhyme Scheme Analyser
description: Scans English verse for syllable stress patterns and end rhymes using a pronunciation dictionary, then labels the metre and rhyme scheme of each stanza.

title: Phonetic Name Matching for Record Linkage
description: Links records whose names are spelled differently but sound alike, by combining phonetic encodings with edit distance, and reports precision and recall on a labelled sample.

title: Transliteration of Indian Language Names into English
description: Converts personal names from Devanagari script into Roman letters with a character-level sequence model and measures exact-match accuracy against several accepted spellings.

title: Dialogue State Tracker for a Restaurant Booking Bot
description: Tracks what a customer has asked for across turns, such as cuisine, party size and time, and updates or retracts slots as the user changes their mind.

title: Emoji Suggestion for Short Messages
description: Suggests an emoji that fits the tone of a short message by training a classifier on messages that already contain emoji, and discusses why many answers are equally valid.

title: Job Posting Scam Detector
description: Identifies fraudulent job advertisements from wording, missing company details and payment requests, and reports which signals drive each decision so users can learn the warning signs.

title: Entity Linking to a Reference Knowledge Base
description: Maps mentions such as Apple or Mercury in text to the correct entry in a small knowledge base using context, and evaluates disambiguation accuracy on ambiguous mentions.

title: Answer Attribution Checker for Retrieval-Based QA
description: Verifies that each sentence in a generated answer is actually supported by one of the retrieved passages, highlights unsupported claims and scores overall faithfulness.

title: Formal and Informal Style Transfer
description: Rewrites informal messages in a formal register and back while preserving meaning, and evaluates style accuracy and content preservation separately.

title: Acronym Disambiguation in Technical Documents
description: Decides what an ambiguous acronym such as CPU, PCA or SDK stands for in a given paragraph, using the surrounding words and a dictionary of expansions found elsewhere in the document.

title: Song Lyrics Mood Classifier
description: Labels song lyrics as happy, sad, angry or calm with a text classifier, and examines where lyrics disagree with the mood a listener would assign.

title: Math Word Problem Solver for Primary Arithmetic
description: Converts short arithmetic word problems into equations and solves them, showing the extracted quantities so a teacher can see where the interpretation went wrong.

title: Claim Matching Against a Fact-Check Archive
description: Retrieves previously fact-checked claims that match a new social media statement, even when the wording differs, and presents the original verdict with its source.

title: Punctuation and Casing Restoration for Speech Transcripts
description: Adds commas, full stops and capital letters to raw transcripts with a token classification model, and reports per-mark precision and recall.

title: Keyword-in-Context Concordancer for Language Learners
description: Lets learners search a text collection for a word and see it in context with the words that commonly appear beside it, sorted by frequency and part of speech.

title: Sentence Embedding Model Comparison on Domain Similarity
description: Compares several sentence embedding models on a hand-built similarity set from one domain, such as cooking or law, and reports which model ranks related sentences best.

title: Gender Bias Audit of Word Embeddings for Occupations
description: Measures how strongly pretrained word vectors associate occupations with gendered words, and tests whether a simple debiasing step reduces the association without harming analogy accuracy.

title: English Dialect Classifier from Written Text
description: Distinguishes regional varieties of English such as British, American and Indian from spelling and vocabulary, and lists the features that carry the most weight for each variety.

title: Question Intent Router for a University Helpdesk
description: Routes student questions to the right department with a small intent classifier, and shows a confidence score so low-confidence questions go to a human instead.
